description: This Python source file defines classes and functions for parsing and extracting documentation and source code blocks from C source files, specifically handling multi-line comment blocks with specific formats.

classes.name: SourceBlockFormat
classes.description: Class representing the format of documentation comment blocks, containing regex patterns for start, column, and end of blocks.

classes.name: SourceBlock
classes.description: Class representing a block of source code or documentation comment, with methods for initialization, location reporting, and debugging dump.

classes.name: SourceProcessor
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing a C source file into blocks, managing the collection of SourceBlock objects.

methods.name: SourceBlockFormat.__init__
methods.description: Initializes regex patterns for recognizing specific documentation comment block formats.

methods.name: SourceBlock.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a source or documentation block, extracting content if applicable.

methods.name: SourceBlock.location
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the filename and line number of the block.

methods.name: SourceBlock.dump
methods.description: Outputs the content of the block for debugging purposes.

methods.name: SourceProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the source processor with empty block list and default state.

methods.name: SourceProcessor.reset
methods.description: Resets the processor, clearing all stored blocks.

methods.name: SourceProcessor.parse_file
methods.description: Reads and parses a C source file, decomposing it into blocks.

methods.name: SourceProcessor.process_normal_line
methods.description: Processes a line to determine if it starts a new block.

methods.name: SourceProcessor.add_block_lines
methods.description: Creates a new SourceBlock from accumulated lines.

methods.name: SourceProcessor.dump
